messages:
alex: quick thread — after today's kernel bump (gpu-kernel-v2) we see a regression on Mixtral MoE serving e2e p95 latency +18% on long-context routes. Repro: canary run from 10:20 UTC. payloads: 2-8k tokens. :thinking:

maya: saw same. Router logits variance increased, top-k routing CPU up. I captured a short profile.

juan: profile paste:
```
# perf top (canary)
- router_score_compute 42.1%
- memcpy_expert_buf 18.5%
- softmax 9.4%
- kv_cache_lookup 7.8%
- mm_gemm 6.2%
```
flame: router->scatter->memcpy is the hot path, esp on long ctx where top-k spikes.

ciara: hypothesis: kernel v2 changed vectorized softmax tiling which hurts router logits numeric stability for Mixtral RoPE scale. Leads to slightly wider logits and more ties -> top-k scanning cost. Also our batching heuristic packs more long requests per batch now.

sam: quick mitigation I tested: reduce router_topk to 8 for long ctx and enable expert_parallelism cap=2. On canary that rolled p95 back to +4%. config snippet:
```
{"topk_long_ctx":8, "expert_par_limit":2, "kv_eviction_margin":0.12}
```

maya: also tried 'kv warmup' where we peek prefix tokens into KV before scoring; cache hit rate jumps from 74%->91% and memcpy drops. rough script:
```
for req in batch:
  run_prefix_cache_warm(req.prefix)
```

perf-bot: canary-ci run #5432: mixtral-canary-v2 -> p95 4.6% over baseline, mem/cpu profiles uploaded https://ci.redwood/example/5432 :white_check_mark:

juan: followups: 1) add adaptive top-k (scale with active expert load) 2) add memcpy coalescing in router scatter 3) add p99 alert for memcpy spikes to ops SLOs

ciara: experiment plan: A) kernel revert vs patch (softmax tiling tweak) B) batching tweak: cap long-ctx per batch to 2 C) router-side presort to avoid scanning full expert list D) KV eviction softening for Mixtral (increase margin)

alex: good plan. I'll open an RFC + rollout checklist. tagging @ops for canary window. Thanks all :pray:

ops-bot: scheduled canary window 2024-07-18T11:30Z -> 2024-07-18T12:00Z, contact oncall ops.

sam: question — any metric for RoPE scale amplification? I saw topk entropy metric go from 1.9->2.6 on canary.

ciara: yes add 'router_topk_entropy' to per-route dashboards, that'll surface RoPE amplification effects.

alex: Created RFC: https://go.redwood/rfc/mixtral-router-kernel-2024 — please add notes.

maya: tl;dr: short-term: cap expert parallelism + kv warmup; mid-term: adaptive top-k + memcpy coalescing; long-term: kernel fix for softmax tiling + RoPE calibration.

juan: I'll start a perf PR for memcpy coalescing, aim EOD.

alex: thanks — will sync in 30.
